items.lede: A critical vulnerability dubbed Java4Shell in OpenJDK, the open-source implementation of Java, can allow unauthenticated attackers to remotely execute code on popular enterprise applications, including Jenkins, Atlassian Jira, Confluence, and Keycloak. [...]
items.title: Critical Java4Shell flaw allows RCE attacks on major Java applications

items.lede: Attackers can crash the JVM or achieve unauthenticated RCE
items.title: Oracle reveals fix-this-ASAP-grade Java4Shell bug that allows attacks on many third-party apps

items.lede: The same tech start-up that discovered a PHP flaw used AI to uncover a critical software bug in one of the world's most popular computer language programs.
items.title: Security flaw found in Java, world's third-largest programming language

items.lede: Millions of sites, services, and devices are at risk of remote code execution thanks to a critical bug in the widely-used Java software. Attackers can trigger the bug by just inputting repeated text
items.title: Critical Java vulnerability puts millions of sites, services, and devices at risk of remote code execution
